meanings.en: suitable or appropriate for the situation
meanings.exampleEn: It was a fitting tribute to a remarkable leader.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu, olağanüstü bir lidere yakışan, yerinde bir saygı gösterisiydi.

meanings.en: not suitable for a particular situation
meanings.exampleEn: His jokes were completely inappropriate for the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Şakaları toplantı için tamamen uygunsuzdu.

meanings.en: not carrying or having a weapon
meanings.exampleEn: The protesters were unarmed and peaceful.
meanings.exampleTr: Protestocular silahsız ve barışçıldı.

meanings.en: made artificially rather than occurring naturally
meanings.exampleEn: This jacket is made from synthetic fibres.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu ceket sentetik liflerden yapılmıştır.

meanings.en: made by people rather than occurring in nature
meanings.exampleEn: The lake is man-made and was built fifty years ago.
meanings.exampleTr: Göl insan yapımıdır ve elli yıl önce inşa edilmiştir.

meanings.en: being asleep at the present time
meanings.exampleEn: Please be quiet near the sleeping baby.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen uyuyan bebeğin yanında sessiz olun.

meanings.en: an assistant to an important person
meanings.exampleEn: A senior aide briefed the president before the speech.
meanings.exampleTr: Kıdemli bir yardımcı, konuşmadan önce başkanı bilgilendirdi.

meanings.en: a man who travels in space
meanings.exampleEn: The children dressed up as a spaceman for the party.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar parti için uzay adamı kostümü giydiler.

meanings.en: an astronaut, especially a Russian one
meanings.exampleEn: The cosmonaut spent six months aboard the space station.
meanings.exampleTr: Kozmonot uzay istasyonunda altı ay geçirdi.

meanings.en: a person who takes part in sports
meanings.exampleEn: She is a talented sportsperson who has won many medals.
meanings.exampleTr: O, birçok madalya kazanmış yetenekli bir sporcudur.

meanings.en: attractive or interesting
meanings.exampleEn: The idea of a weekend at the beach sounds very appealing.
meanings.exampleTr: Sahilde bir hafta sonu geçirme fikri çok cazip geliyor.

meanings.en: people who watch an event, especially a sporting one
meanings.exampleEn: Thousands of spectators filled the stadium.
meanings.exampleTr: Binlerce seyirci stadyumu doldurdu.

meanings.en: people who watch television or something on a screen
meanings.exampleEn: Millions of viewers tuned in for the final episode.
meanings.exampleTr: Milyonlarca izleyici son bölüm için ekran başına geçti.

meanings.en: working by itself without external control
meanings.exampleEn: The factory installed a self-acting valve to regulate pressure.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika, basıncı düzenlemek için otomatik bir vana taktı.

meanings.en: by means of machinery; or without thinking
meanings.exampleEn: The parts are assembled mechanically on the production line.
meanings.exampleTr: Parçalar üretim hattında makineyle birleştirilir.

meanings.en: by hand rather than automatically
meanings.exampleEn: You can adjust the settings manually if you prefer.
meanings.exampleTr: İsterseniz ayarları elle değiştirebilirsiniz.

meanings.en: to escape or avoid something cleverly
meanings.exampleEn: He managed to evade his pursuers in the crowded market.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalabalık pazarda peşindekilerden sıyrılmayı başardı.

meanings.en: to move quickly to avoid something
meanings.exampleEn: She had to dodge the ball thrown at her.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendisine atılan toptan kaçmak için yana sıçramak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: situated at the back, especially of an animal
meanings.exampleEn: The horse stood up on its hind legs.
meanings.exampleTr: At arka bacaklarının üzerinde dikildi.

meanings.en: the scenery or setting behind something
meanings.exampleEn: The mountains formed a stunning backdrop for the photos.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağlar fotoğraflar için muhteşem bir arka plan oluşturdu.

meanings.en: the part of a view nearest to the observer
meanings.exampleEn: A small boat appears in the foreground of the painting.
meanings.exampleTr: Tablonun ön planında küçük bir tekne görünüyor.

meanings.en: a meal cooked and eaten outdoors
meanings.exampleEn: We invited the neighbours to a cookout in our backyard.
meanings.exampleTr: Komşuları arka bahçemizdeki açık hava barbeküsüne davet ettik.

meanings.en: to hinder or impede movement or progress
meanings.exampleEn: Heavy snow hampered the rescue efforts.
meanings.exampleTr: Yoğun kar, kurtarma çalışmalarını engelledi.

meanings.en: a large area of sea partly surrounded by land
meanings.exampleEn: They sailed across the gulf to reach the island.
meanings.exampleTr: Adaya ulaşmak için körfezi geçerek yelken açtılar.

meanings.en: a small sheltered bay on the coast
meanings.exampleEn: We swam in a quiet cove away from the crowds.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalabalıktan uzak, sakin bir koyda yüzdük.

meanings.en: the quality of being lovely or beautiful
meanings.exampleEn: The loveliness of the garden took her breath away.
meanings.exampleTr: Bahçenin güzelliği onun nefesini kesti.

meanings.en: the quality of being unpleasant to look at
meanings.exampleEn: The ugliness of the old factory spoiled the view.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski fabrikanın çirkinliği manzarayı bozdu.

meanings.en: to beg someone earnestly to do something
meanings.exampleEn: She implored him to stay just a little longer.
meanings.exampleTr: Biraz daha kalması için ona yalvardı.

meanings.en: a person who is new to and inexperienced at something
meanings.exampleEn: As a novice, he made several mistakes on his first day.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir acemi olarak ilk gününde birkaç hata yaptı.

meanings.en: the start or beginning of something
meanings.exampleEn: From the outset, the project was poorly planned.
meanings.exampleTr: Proje en başından beri kötü planlanmıştı.

meanings.en: a thing with distinct and independent existence
meanings.exampleEn: The company is now a separate legal entity.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket artık ayrı bir tüzel kişiliktir.

meanings.en: a person's stomach (informal)
meanings.exampleEn: The little boy said his tummy hurt.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük çocuk karnının ağrıdığını söyledi.

meanings.en: a strip of material used for fastening or carrying
meanings.exampleEn: The strap of her bag broke on the way home.
meanings.exampleTr: Çantasının kayışı eve dönerken koptu.

meanings.en: an amount of food or drink that fills the mouth
meanings.exampleEn: He took a big mouthful of soup.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir ağız dolusu çorba aldı.

meanings.en: to take small bites of food
meanings.exampleEn: She nibbled at her biscuit while reading.
meanings.exampleTr: Okurken bisküvisini azar azar ısırdı.

meanings.en: a dark board for writing on with chalk
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher wrote the date on the chalkboard.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen tarihi kara tahtaya yazdı.

meanings.en: a warm bed covering with padding stitched between layers
meanings.exampleEn: Grandmother made a beautiful patchwork quilt.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyükanne güzel bir yama işi yorgan yaptı.

meanings.en: a woman or girl with dark brown hair
meanings.exampleEn: The brunette in the photo is my sister.
meanings.exampleTr: Fotoğraftaki esmer kız benim kız kardeşim.

meanings.en: to cook gently just below boiling point
meanings.exampleEn: Let the sauce simmer for twenty minutes.
meanings.exampleTr: Sosu yirmi dakika hafif ateşte kaynatın.

meanings.en: a woman's undergarment supporting the breasts
meanings.exampleEn: The shop sells brassieres in many sizes.
meanings.exampleTr: Mağaza birçok bedende sütyen satıyor.

meanings.en: a pedal that controls a vehicle's speed
meanings.exampleEn: He pressed the accelerator and the car sped up.
meanings.exampleTr: Gaz pedalına bastı ve araba hızlandı.

meanings.en: a main branch of a tree
meanings.exampleEn: A bird sat on the lowest bough of the oak.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir kuş meşenin en alttaki büyük dalına kondu.

meanings.en: to place a dead body in a grave or tomb
meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers were interred with full honours.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerler tam bir törenle defnedildi.

meanings.en: to remove something from the ground or uncover it
meanings.exampleEn: They had to dig up the old pipes to fix the leak.
meanings.exampleTr: Sızıntıyı tamir etmek için eski boruları kazıp çıkarmak zorunda kaldılar.

meanings.en: a woody plant smaller than a tree
meanings.exampleEn: She planted a row of shrubs along the fence.
meanings.exampleTr: Çitin boyunca bir sıra çalı dikti.

meanings.en: a capital letter
meanings.exampleEn: Begin each sentence with an uppercase letter.
meanings.exampleTr: Her cümleye büyük harfle başlayın.

meanings.en: a small letter, not a capital
meanings.exampleEn: Passwords should include at least one lowercase letter.
meanings.exampleTr: Şifreler en az bir küçük harf içermelidir.

meanings.en: an area for parking cars (American English)
meanings.exampleEn: We left the car in the parking lot near the mall.
meanings.exampleTr: Arabayı alışveriş merkezinin yanındaki otoparkta bıraktık.

meanings.en: a large strongly built building for defence
meanings.exampleEn: The ancient fortress stood high on the hill.
meanings.exampleTr: Antik kale tepenin üzerinde yüksekte duruyordu.

meanings.en: a person who leads a meeting or organization
meanings.exampleEn: The chairperson opened the meeting at nine o'clock.
meanings.exampleTr: Başkan toplantıyı saat dokuzda açtı.

meanings.en: to shout disapproval at a performer or speaker
meanings.exampleEn: The crowd began to boo when the referee made the call.
meanings.exampleTr: Hakem kararı verince kalabalık yuhalamaya başladı.

meanings.en: the state of being an adult
meanings.exampleEn: He moved abroad in early adulthood.
meanings.exampleTr: Yetişkinliğinin ilk yıllarında yurt dışına taşındı.

meanings.en: a small hot-tasting pepper used in cooking
meanings.exampleEn: Add a chili pepper if you like spicy food.
meanings.exampleTr: Acılı yemek seviyorsanız bir acı biber ekleyin.

meanings.en: to make a short high sound like a bird, or post on social media
meanings.exampleEn: The birds began to tweet at dawn.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuşlar şafakta cıvıldamaya başladı.

meanings.en: in a clear or obvious way
meanings.exampleEn: She spoke plainly so everyone could understand.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkes anlasın diye açıkça konuştu.

meanings.en: without colour, or lacking interest
meanings.exampleEn: Water is a colourless liquid.
meanings.exampleTr: Su renksiz bir sıvıdır.

meanings.en: a tall vertical structure used as support
meanings.exampleEn: The roof was held up by stone pillars.
meanings.exampleTr: Çatı taş sütunlarla ayakta tutuluyordu.

meanings.en: warm, comfortable and welcoming
meanings.exampleEn: We sat by the fire in a cosy little room.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirin küçük bir odada şöminenin yanında oturduk.

meanings.en: a flat piece of wood, or a group that manages an organization
meanings.exampleEn: The notice was pinned to the board in the hallway.
meanings.exampleTr: Duyuru koridordaki panoya iğnelenmişti.

meanings.en: to compare one thing to another
meanings.exampleEn: Critics liken his style to that of early jazz musicians.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler onun tarzını ilk dönem caz müzisyenlerine benzetiyor.

meanings.en: to complain in a low, discontented way
meanings.exampleEn: He grumbled about the long wait at the airport.
meanings.exampleTr: Havalimanındaki uzun bekleyiş hakkında söylendi.

meanings.en: a real or imagined cause for complaint
meanings.exampleEn: The workers filed a grievance against the company.
meanings.exampleTr: İşçiler şirkete karşı bir şikayette bulundu.

meanings.en: completed or brought to an end
meanings.exampleEn: The finished report was on her desk by noon.
meanings.exampleTr: Tamamlanmış rapor öğleye kadar masasındaydı.

meanings.en: not whole or finished
meanings.exampleEn: The form was returned because it was incomplete.
meanings.exampleTr: Form eksik olduğu için geri gönderildi.

meanings.en: a person who writes songs
meanings.exampleEn: She is a talented songwriter as well as a singer.
meanings.exampleTr: O, şarkıcı olmasının yanında yetenekli bir şarkı yazarıdır.

meanings.en: a lack of worry or interest
meanings.exampleEn: He watched the chaos with complete unconcern.
meanings.exampleTr: Kargaşayı tam bir kayıtsızlıkla izledi.

meanings.en: confident in one's own abilities
meanings.exampleEn: She gave a self-assured answer to every question.
meanings.exampleTr: Her soruya kendinden emin bir yanıt verdi.

meanings.en: lacking confidence or stability
meanings.exampleEn: He felt insecure about his new job.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni işi konusunda kendini güvensiz hissediyordu.

meanings.en: confused and unsure what to do
meanings.exampleEn: The tourists looked bewildered by the busy streets.
meanings.exampleTr: Turistler kalabalık sokaklar karşısında şaşkın görünüyorlardı.

meanings.en: to think about something deeply and at length
meanings.exampleEn: She sat quietly to contemplate her future.
meanings.exampleTr: Geleceğini derin derin düşünmek için sessizce oturdu.
